title: Following CHAOS, Sebi Goes Back to VWAP Settlement

Under the new guidelines, volume-weighted average prices will be used during the last half-hour of normal trading. Trading for stocks will now last until 3:30 pm, while closing auction sessions will continue until 3:40 pm.

title: Wipro faces slow recovery as revenue and deal wins lag peers

Slight enhancements were noted in operating margins, attributed to increased efficiency and favorable currency fluctuations.

title: Kotak MF suspends subscriptions in two debt funds holding Yes Bank AT1 bonds

This decision follows the zero valuation of Yes Bank AT1 bonds after a significant bank reconstruction in March 2020. Similarly, Tata Mutual Fund has restricted new investments in the Tata Gold ETF Fund of Fund, although existing investments and redemptions will continue uninterrupted.

title: Gold eases after climbing over 1% in previous session

US producer prices surged the most in over four years, driven by escalating costs. Meanwhile, spot silver and platinum dipped, while palladium slightly increased amid persistent geopolitical concerns. Analysts are vigilantly evaluating how prospective rate hikes might influence gold's status as an inflationary safeguard.
